# PRESTOplay Web Code Samples

> Runnable code samples for PRESTOplay for Web Apps (npm: `@castlabs/prestoplay`),
> castLabs' browser video player SDK for DASH and HLS. The PRESTOplay code of
> each sample is in a JavaScript module (`examples/**/<name>.js`). Each module
> starts with a comment listing the modules, external dependencies, APIs and
> gotchas for that sample, and the element IDs it expects from its page.

Each module runs in an HTML page with the same name next to it
(`<name>.html`). The page is scaffolding and is not needed in an app: the
import map, external `<script>` tags (e.g. mux.js or vendor SDKs, listed as
`External` in the module comment), the `<prestoplay-header>` component,
`examples/styles.css`, the inline styles and the markup. The React sample is
the exception: its code is inline in `examples/react/react.html`.

## Core concepts

- The SDK is split into modules. `@castlabs/prestoplay` (`cl.core.js`) exports
  the `clpp` namespace. Feature modules are imported only for their side
  effects, before a player is created:
  `import "@castlabs/prestoplay/cl.mse"`.
- `cl.mse` provides playback through Media Source Extensions and is needed by
  every sample. Add `cl.dash` for DASH and `cl.hls` for HLS.
- Each feature has its own module: `cl.playlist`, `cl.thumbnails`, `cl.ima`
  (Google IMA ads), `cl.vtt` (WebVTT and SRT subtitles), `cl.ttml` (TTML
  subtitles), `cl.htmlcue` (HTML subtitle renderer), `cl.onboard` (DRMtoday Onboard), `cl.persistent` (stored
  DRM licenses, with `cl.crypto`), `cl.cast` (Chromecast sender and receiver),
  `cl.airplay`, `cl.simid` (SIMID ads), `cl.verimatrix` (Verimatrix VCAS Ultra DRM), `cl.vr` (360° video), `cl.broadpeak`, `cl.conviva`, `cl.muxdata` and `cl.youbora` (NPAW).
- The samples load the SDK through an import map that points at files in
  `node_modules`. In an app that uses a bundler, import the same specifiers
  directly; there is no import map.
- Include `@castlabs/prestoplay/clpp.styles.css` for the player UI styles.
- HLS samples load `mux.js` as a global `<script>` before the SDK. It
  transmuxes MPEG-TS and raw AAC segments for MSE playback.
- Creating a player:
  `new clpp.Player(videoElOrId, playerConfig, {containerEl})`. Plugin settings
  go in `playerConfig` (e.g. `{conviva: {...}}`). Per-content settings go in
  `player.open({source, autoplay, ...})`, which returns a Promise.
- Errors: listen with `player.on('error', e => e.detail)`, and handle the
  Promise returned by `player.open()` as well.
- Cleanup: call `player.destroy()` when the player is no longer needed. See
  the React sample.
- DRM: set `drm: {env, customData}` in `player.open()`. `env` is
  `'DRMtoday'`, `'DRMtoday_STAGING'`, `'DRMtoday_DEMO'`, `'HeaderDrm'` (any
  license server that authorizes with HTTP headers) or a custom environment.
  DRM needs a secure context (HTTPS or localhost).
- Networking: `player.getNetworkEngine()` returns the network engine. Use
  `addRequestModifier` and `addResponseModifier` to change requests and
  responses, with `clpp.net.RequestType` to tell them apart. An async modifier
  must resolve with the request or response object. Modifiers stay registered
  after `player.release()`. Native HLS on Safari bypasses them.
- Plugins: get one with `player.getPlugin(id)`. Register custom plugins with
  `clpp.Player.registerPlugin(factory)` before creating the player.
- Values marked `TODO` (account keys, vendor SDK paths) must be filled in
  before a sample works.

## Examples

- [Basic playback](examples/basic.js): Load and play a DASH or HLS URL. This is the minimal setup.
- [React integration](examples/react/react.html): A React `Player` component with custom play/pause, a seek bar and fullscreen. Creates the player in `useEffect` and destroys it in the cleanup function.
- [Playlist](examples/playlist/playlist.js): `clpp.Playlist` plays DASH and HLS items back-to-back with `next()`, `previous()` and `goTo()`.
- [Custom plugin](examples/plugins/stats_overlay.js): Implements `clpp.PlayerPlugin` and `clpp.PlayerPluginFactory` (a stats overlay) and shows each plugin lifecycle callback.
- [Google IMA ads](examples/advertising/ima.js): Client-side pre-, mid- and post-roll ads from a VMAP ad tag, with ad events and the `clpp.ads.IAd` interface.
- [Ad UI and skipping](examples/advertising/ad_ui.js): Render a custom UI from ad events: `IAd.getPositionInSequence()`/`getSequenceLength()` for an ad label, `player.isPaused()` re-rendered on `AD_STARTED`/`AD_PAUSED`/`AD_RESUMED`, seek controls gated by `IAd.canSeek()`, and a skip button from `IAd.getSkipTimeOffset()` and `player.getAdsManager().skip()`. Read the time into the ad from `player.getAdsManager().getPosition()`, because the IMA `IAd.getPosition()` always returns 0.
- [SIMID interactive ads](examples/advertising/simid.js): `simid: {creatives: [{url, startTime, duration, preload, adParameters}]}` shows SIMID creatives at set content times, with the `SIMID_CREATIVE_STARTED` and `SIMID_CREATIVE_STOPPED` events. Experimental, no ad server.
- [360° video](examples/vr/vr.js): `vr: {enable, attachMouseListener, fieldOfView, sensitivity}` renders an equirectangular stream on WebGL; the `clpp.vr.VrPlugin` instance moves the camera with `moveCamera(x, y)` and zooms with `setCameraFieldOfView()`.
- [DASH embedded thumbnails](examples/thumbnails/thumbnails.js): Thumbnails from the DASH manifest's image AdaptationSet, with no `thumbnails` config. All thumbnail samples share the seek-bar hover preview in `examples/thumbnails/thumbnail_preview.js` (`plugin.get(time)`, `thumb.load()`, `thumb.element(width)`).
- [Single-image thumbnails](examples/thumbnails/single.js): `thumbnails: {mode: 'SINGLE', url, duration, templateKey, preload}`. One image per thumbnail, `$index$` counts from 1.
- [Grid thumbnails](examples/thumbnails/grid.js): `thumbnails: {mode: 'GRID', url, duration, gridSize}`. Sprite sheets, `duration` is per thumbnail, `gridSize` is `'COLUMNSxROWS'`.
- [WebVTT thumbnails](examples/thumbnails/webvtt.js): `thumbnails: {mode: 'WEBVTT', url}`. Cues point at images with optional `#xywh=` regions, relative URLs resolve against the VTT URL.
- [BIF thumbnails](examples/thumbnails/bif.js): `thumbnails: {mode: 'BIF', url}`. The whole BIF file is downloaded before thumbnails show.
- [Subtitle text styling](examples/subtitles/text_style.js): Style subtitles with the `textStyle` setting (font, colors, edge type).
- [SRT subtitles](examples/subtitles/srt.js): Side-load an SRT file with `remoteTextTracks` and select it with `preferredTextLanguage`.
- [Conviva analytics](examples/analytics/conviva.js): Conviva integration through the `conviva` player config, created on Load from the customer key and gateway URL entered on the page. The vendor SDK is not on npm.
- [Mux Data analytics](examples/analytics/muxdata.js): Mux Data integration through the `muxdata` player config, created on Load from the environment key entered on the page, plus custom events.
- [Broadpeak analytics and SSAI](examples/analytics/broadpeak.js): Broadpeak integration through the `broadpeak` player config (`broadpeakDomainNames`, `analyticsAddress`, `adTracking`, `adParameters`, `sessionOptions`), created on Load from the form, with SSAI ad events and `player.getAdsManager().skip()`. SmartLib comes from Broadpeak's npm registry (`.npmrc`) and is loaded as global scripts.
- [NPAW v7 analytics](examples/analytics/npaw_v7.js): NPAW (Youbora) integration through the `npaw` player config, created on Load from the account code entered on the page, with a custom `errorFilter`.
- [DRMtoday playback](examples/drm/drmtoday.js): DRM-protected DASH from DRMtoday with `drm: {env, customData}`, plus the `DRM_SESSION_CREATED` and `DRM_LICENSE_REQUESTED` events.
- [DRMtoday Onboard](examples/drm/onboard.js): The `DRMtodayOnboard` environment from `cl.onboard` with `drm.customData: {baseUrl, widevineUrl, playreadyUrl, fairplayUrl, serverCertificate}`, for licenses from an offline DRMtoday Onboard server.
- [Custom license server](examples/drm/header_drm.js): The `HeaderDrm` environment with Widevine, PlayReady and FairPlay license URLs, the FairPlay certificate and custom request headers.
- [Persistent license](examples/drm/persistent_license.js): Store a license with `drm.offlineId`, the `DRM_SESSION_PERSISTED` event and `clpp.persistent.removeLicense()`.
- [WebVTT and TTML subtitles](examples/subtitles/sidecar.js): Side-load WebVTT and TTML files for DASH and HLS with `remoteTextTracks`.
- [Low-latency live](examples/live/low_latency.js): `lowLatencyMode`, live edge chasing in `streaming`, `manifest.clockSyncUri`, and a latency readout from `getPresentationStartTime()`.
- [Live delay](examples/live/live_delay.js): `suggestedPresentationDelay` and the buffering goals for live DASH and HLS, compared with the delay set by the stream.
- [Request and response modifiers](examples/network/request_modifiers.js): An async auth header, a segment query parameter, a manifest rewrite and a response log through the network engine.
- [CMCD](examples/network/cmcd.js): Common Media Client Data through the `cmcd` config, with the data sent shown for each request.
- [Timeline cues](examples/events/timeline_cues.js): `TIMELINE_CUE_ADDED`/`ENTER`/`EXIT` and `getTimelineCues()` for SCTE-35 events in a DASH MPD and HLS `EXT-X-DATERANGE` tags.
- [Chromecast sender](examples/cast/chromecast_sender.js): `cl.cast` with `clpp.cast.onReady`, `CastProxy`, the cast status events and custom receiver messages. Needs a receiver app ID.
- [AirPlay](examples/cast/airplay.js): The AirPlay plugin's device menu and events, with native HLS on Safari, plus `setDrmCustomDataModifier` for single-use DRM tokens.
- [Audio player](examples/audio/audio.js): Audio-only HLS in an `<audio>` element with `disableContainer: true` and custom controls.
- [Player configuration](examples/player/configuration.js): `autoplay`, `muted`, `volume`, `startTime`, `streaming` buffering goals and `attemptParameters` for segments and manifests, the `AUTOPLAY_NOT_ALLOWED` event and the rejected `open()` when the browser blocks autoplay.
- [Player surface](examples/player/surface.js): An explicit `containerEl`, `player.getSurface()` with `addElementToContainer()`/`removeElementFromContainer()` for an overlay, `.clpp-container`/`.clpp-video` style overrides, and the `disableContainer` trade-offs.
- [Simple UI](examples/player/simple_ui.js): A `.ui-container` passed as `containerEl` with an absolute poster and play button on top, `player.play()` from the button, and a `ui-started` class added on `playing` to hide them.
- [Smart TV](examples/player/smart_tv.js): `pauseWhenInBackground` or release/reopen on `visibilitychange`, the polyfill script, low `bufferBehind` and `restrictions.maxHeight`, and remote keys (`tizen.tvinputdevice.registerKey()`, Tizen/webOS key codes). Runs in a desktop browser too.
- [Player events](examples/events/player_events.js): `player.on()`, `one()` and `off()` with HTML5 media events and `clpp.events` (`STATE_CHANGED`, `BUFFERING_STARTED`/`ENDED`, `TRACKS_ADDED`, `*_TRACK_CHANGED`, `BITRATE_CHANGED`, `RELEASING`).
- [Error handling](examples/events/errors.js): `clpp.events.ERROR` and the `player.open()` rejection, `clpp.Error` category/severity/code, `error.data.request` retry attempts and `manifest.attemptParameters`, for HTTP 404, an unreachable host and an invalid manifest.
- [Audio and subtitle tracks](examples/tracks/tracks.js): `preferredAudioLanguage`/`preferredTextLanguage` with fallback arrays, and `player.getTrackManager()` to list and switch audio and text tracks (`setTextTrack(null)` turns subtitles off) and to lock a video rendition (`setVideoRendition(null)` turns ABR back on).
- [Custom DRM environment](examples/drm/license_modifiers.js): `clpp.drm.DrmEnvironment`, `setDrmSystem` and `registerDrmEnvironment`, with an async `licenseRequest` modifier that adds an auth header, a `licenseResponse` modifier that unwraps a JSON-wrapped Widevine license, `sessionContext.customData`, and a second FairPlay environment with `extractContentId`.
- [Custom FairPlay key request](examples/drm/fairplay_custom_payload.js): A FairPlay DRM system with `transformInitData` (`clpp.utils.FairplayUtils.extractContentId` and `createFairplayPayload` with your own content ID), a `licenseRequest` that sends the SPC in a JSON body, a `licenseResponse` that unwraps the CKC, and `sessionContext.customData` to pass the key ID between them.
- [Multiple DRM environments](examples/drm/multiple_environments.js): Each asset carries its own `drm` config (`env: 'DRMtoday'` with merchant custom data, `env: 'HeaderDrm'` with license URLs and headers), passed to `player.open()` on every load to switch providers in one player.
- [Verimatrix VCAS Ultra](examples/drm/verimatrix_vcas.js): The `VerimatrixVCAS` environment from `cl.verimatrix` with `drm.customData: {deviceId, authenticator, widevineLicenseUrl, playReadyLicenseUrl, fairPlayLicenseUrl, fairPlayCertificateUrl, licenseRequestVuidLocation}`, plus the `clpp.verimatrix.Vcas` enums for header names and the FairPlay asset ID.
- [Fast channel zapping](examples/live/fast_zapping.js): Experimental `clpp.playlist.McPlaylist` with `setItems()`, `setIndex()`, `playFirst()`, `playNext()`, `playPrev()`, the `update` event and fast-switch `streaming` settings (`bufferingGoal`, `startAtSegmentBoundary`, `ignoreDrift`), with a zap time readout.
- [Seamless playlist](examples/playlist/sc_playlist.js): Experimental `clpp.playlist.ScPlaylist` (extends `clpp.Player`) with `openPlaylist()`, `addItem()`, `seekWith()`, `getTimeline()` windows, `playlist: {timeline, startTime, endTime, cropTimeline}`, the `SC_PLAYLIST_*` events and timeline cues with `configurationId`.
- [Chromecast receiver](examples/cast/chromecast_receiver.js): A custom Web Receiver app with `clpp.cast.Receiver` (`init`, `setQueue(clpp.cast.createCastQueue())`, `start`, `stop`), `setPlayerConfigInterceptor`, and custom messages on `urn:x-cast:castlabs` that pair with the sender sample. Must be hosted and registered in the Cast console.
